# wallix-bastion_authdomain_oidc (Resource)

Provides an OIDC authentication domain resource (API v3.12 or later). The identity provider
connection is a `wallix-bastion_externalauth_oidc` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wallix-bastion_externalauth_oidc" "corporate" {
  authentication_name      = "corporate_oidc"
  timeout                  = 30
  client_id                = "bastion"
  client_secret_wo         = var.oidc_client_secret
  client_secret_wo_version = 1

  claim_customization {
    username = "preferred_username"
    group    = "groups"
  }
}

resource "wallix-bastion_authdomain_oidc" "corporate" {
  domain_name          = "corporate.oidc"
  auth_domain_name     = "corporate.com"
  external_auths       = [wallix-bastion_externalauth_oidc.corporate.authentication_name]
  default_email_domain = "corporate.com"
  default_language     = "en"
  label                = "Corporate SSO"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_domain_name` (String)
- `default_email_domain` (String)
- `default_language` (String)
- `domain_name` (String) Domain name: letters, digits, dots and hyphens.
- `external_auths` (List of String) Names of the OIDC external authentications of the domain.
- `label` (String) Label shown on the login page.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `secondary_auth` (List of String) Names of the secondary authentication methods.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the authentication domain on the Bastion.

## Usage Notes

### external_auths

`external_auths` holds the `authentication_name` of at least one OIDC external authentication.
Reference the resource, as above, so that Terraform creates it first and destroys it last: the
Bastion refuses to delete an external authentication still used by a domain. When an external
authentication is renamed, the Bastion updates the domains that use it.

### Mappings

The mappings of the domain's groups to Bastion user groups are `wallix-bastion_authdomain_mapping`
resources.

## Import

OIDC authentication domain can be imported using its `domain_name`, e.g.

```shell
terraform import wallix-bastion_authdomain_oidc.corporate corporate.oidc
```
